name: practice-lab-tests
description: Playwright + TypeScript test suite for Practice Lab (dhanoapartners.com): UI, API, accessibility, self-healing locators, RAG, LLM-as-judge, AI agent and banking tests.

scripts.test:ui: playwright test specs/shop.spec.ts specs/checkout.spec.ts specs/playground.spec.ts specs/hover.spec.ts specs/site.spec.ts
scripts.har:record: cross-env UPDATE_HAR=1 playwright test specs/network.spec.ts -g HAR
scripts.har:record:mock: cross-env LAB_URL=http://localhost:8799 UPDATE_HAR=1 playwright test specs/network.spec.ts -g HAR
scripts.test:all: cross-env LAB_URL=http://localhost:8799 LAB_LLM=1 VISUAL=1 playwright test --workers=2
